items.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
items.content: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
items.content: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

items.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
items.content: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
items.content: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

items.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
items.content: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.

items.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
items.content: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

items.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
items.content: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

items.title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
items.content: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.

items.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
items.content: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

items.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
items.content: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

items.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
items.content: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
items.content: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

items.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
items.content: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

items.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
items.content: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

items.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
items.content: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

items.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
items.content: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

items.title: Ex-FTX COO calls out Netflix over CZ’s ‘Asian mafia’ portrayal
items.content: Constance Waing said Netflix used racist stereotypes in its portrayal of CZ and misrepresented life at FTX before the exchange’s collapse.

items.title: Ukraine passes bill to legalize crypto and tax profits at 23%
items.content: Ukraine’s parliament passed a crypto regulation bill after three years of legislative work, with the new rules set to take effect in July 2027.

items.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
items.content: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

items.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
items.content: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

items.title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
items.content: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.

items.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
items.content: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

items.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
items.content: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

items.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
items.content: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

items.title: EU seeks up to $55B for AI and quantum computing fund: Report
items.content: Hackers already use AI to target crypto exchanges, while future quantum computers could break the cryptography that protects users’ funds.

items.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
items.content: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

items.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
items.content: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

items.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
items.content: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.
